item.title: Mitsubishi Versa Van Returns In The Philippines With P 1.649M Price Tag
item.description: After being leaked in government paperwork even by their very-own sales agents, Mitsubishi Motors Philippines Corporation (MMPC) formally launches the all-new 2026 Versa Van. Marking a much-awaited return of an iconic nameplate that has long been associated with versatility, durability, and dependable performance, the Versa Van is once again set to become a reliable partner for organizations and businesses that move people every day.Read More »

item.title: VinFast PH Revises Battery Subscription Policy Reducing Ownership Cost By Up To 20 Percent
item.description: VinFast announces an updated battery subscription policy for the Philippine market, significantly reducing upfront investment costs and simplifying electric vehicle ownership. This pioneering policy once again reinforces VinFast’s commitment to a customer-centric approach in advancing green mobility in the Philippines.Read More »

item.title: Financial Guru Kenta Kon To Become New Toyota CEO
item.description: Toyota’s current Chief Financial Officer, Kenta Kon, will be the next CEO of Toyota Motor Corporation. The changes to the board will take effect on April 1. Meanwhile, current CEO Koji Sato will assume the position of Vice Chairman as well as a newly established role of Chief Industry Officer.Read More »

item.title: Superfest Manila Returns To City Of Dreams This February 7-8
item.description: The engines are roaring once again as 2026 Superfest Manila, presented by Bumper to Bumper Car Show, returns for its third year at City of Dreams Manila on February 7 and 8. This annual showcase merges motoring passion, lifestyle entertainment, and global car culture with over 80 standout vehicles, interactive activities and a chance to win the raffle draw grand prize for an all-expense paid trip to Japan by Autotour Japan. Participation in the raffle is exclusive for Melco Club members.Read Mor

item.title: Review: 2026 Hyundai Elantra 1.6 HEV Premium 6DCT
item.description: Let’s admit one thing for a second: before the seventh-generation Elantra reached Philippine shores, the nameplate wasn’t synonymous with cutting-edge tech. While they’ve managed to re-write the design book on occasion, they often hide something more modest under the hood. This time, Hyundai has decided to go all out and pair those head-turning looks with a powertrain to match. The result? A great value hybrid compact sedan that’s also, gasp, fun to drive.Read More »

item.title: Toyota Corolla Cross GR Sport Gets Styling Tweaks This 2026
